name: Deterministic Exact-Match Quote Guard for AI and OCR Inputs
description: Validates untrusted extracted line items, accepts only exact synthetic catalog references, ignores claimed prices, and returns HTTP 422 with `NEEDS_REVIEW` and no total for caller-side handling.

source.path: Other_Integrations_and_Use_Cases/Deterministic Exact-Match Quote Guard for AI and OCR Inputs.json
source.n8nName: Deterministic Exact-Match Quote Guard for AI and OCR Inputs

setup: "Receive Synthetic Request" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /deterministic-exact-match-quote). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.

notes:
## Setup and safety boundary
- The catalog, prices, labor rate, travel fee, and VAT are synthetic fixtures. Replace them with an authenticated source and approved business rules.
- The webhook has no authentication in this template. Add Header Auth or JWT Auth before publishing it.
- Treat `extracted_items` as untrusted AI or OCR output. Prices supplied by that input are ignored.
- Unknown references return `NEEDS_REVIEW` with `totals: null`. Keep a human approval step before sending a quote.
- Test concurrency, rounding, taxes, discounts, audit storage, and retries against your own acceptance cases.
